description: This file contains utility functions for managing DHCPv4 client operations, including fetching DHCP options, starting, and stopping DHCPv4 clients, with platform-specific and configuration-based logic.

methods.name: get_dhcpv4_opt_list
methods.description: Fetches DHCP request and send options based on platform and configuration.

methods.name: start_dhcpv4_client
methods.description: Builds DHCP request/send options and starts the DHCPv4 client process.

methods.name: stop_dhcpv4_client
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv4 client process for a specified interface.
